title: ProbStack — Random Stacking on Trees
summary: Lean 4 formalization of a deterministic finite-path necessity theorem for graph-pebbling stackability: a positive-mass nonstackable path configuration above an explicit mass threshold must contain an actual directed integer branch message at most -h. The package also verifies the exact fixed-total corollary at total n*mu, forcing a message at most -(2*mu-1). The project's two-sided random path threshold theorem is not part of this Palomar result.
